name: Sort
description: Sorts the upstream array. Stable — preserves input order for elements with equal keys. Pair with Limit to take the cheapest N fares, or with Distinct to dedupe before sorting.

params.name: sortKey
params.description: JSONPath relative to each element. Omit to sort whole elements (numeric / string compare).

params.name: nulls
params.description: Where to place null / missing keys.

enum.label: Error
enum.description: Throw when any element has a null key — strict mode.
